sources.note: Authenticated Reddit thread states this is the initial native Vita release and directly links the source repository.
Repository README describes a native hardware-accelerated PS Vita/PSTV port based on kylofon's static recompilation.
Independent upstream static recompilation identified by the Vita repository README.

findings: The Reddit author announced an initial native Vita release. The linked GitHub repository contains VitaSDK/VitaGL build material and a v0.1 release with TestDriveVita.vpk. Proprietary game data is not bundled and must come from the user's own original game files.
repository_identity: smart-pickle/TestDrive-Vita; README identifies a native PS Vita/PSTV port of Test Drive (1987) built from kylofon's static recompilation.
vita_hardware_result: Developer reports the initial release runs on Vita; the repository describes native Vita/PSTV hardware acceleration. VitaHarbor did not independently benchmark the binary.
vita_evidence: VitaSDK/VitaGL build instructions in the repository
Reddit release post reports the Vita native version running
author_linkage: The Reddit post by gainusha directly links smart-pickle/TestDrive-Vita; the repository README build section also references gainusha/TestDriveVita as its clone target.

corroboration.detail: GitHub v0.1 contains the Vita-specific TestDriveVita.vpk asset.
Repository credits kylofon/testdrive-enhanced as the upstream static recompilation.

risk_disposition: No risk signals were recorded for this candidate.
